plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Industrial Maintenance Technician Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 3, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7699/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 11; this seed = 8 + 3 = 11 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 8 / 3 headers. In-plan prereqs: IMMT 220 requires IMMT 120, 130, and 140 with grades of 'C' or better; IMMT 240 requires IMMT 120, 130, and 140 with grades of 'C' or better. Sequencing note (documented): IMMT 120, 130, and 140 are taken during the 1st 8-week term and IMMT 220 during the 2nd 8-week term. Certificate of Achievement requirements: grade of 'C' or better in each major course. Industrial Maintenance Technician, Business & Industry Meta Majors. Distinct from the Electro-Mechanical Technician (map 7697) and Industrial Controls Technician (map 7698) certificates. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
